features.feature: Priority inflation
features.detail: **Priority inflation:** most rows across the addenda are P0, so P0 no longer means anything. Fix: Re-rank: P0 = needed for a v1.0 that can ship safely; P1 = v1.x; P2 = later. Cap P0 at roughly 25% of rows. Builder produces the re-ranked list in `PLAN-INDEX.json`.
features.section: P. Problems found inside the three plans (fix before building)

features.feature: M19 (desktop UI) is overloaded
features.detail: **M19 (desktop UI) is overloaded**: it receives rows from all three docs. Fix: Split into M19a shell/layout, M19b chat/composer, M19c review/diff/terminal docks, M19d fleet/board/memory views, M19e settings/forms/wizard, M19f polish/a11y/i18n.
features.section: P. Problems found inside the three plans (fix before building)

features.feature: Same for M11, M17, M22
features.detail: Same for M11, M17, M22. Fix: Split M11 into code-intel core vs engineering tools; M17 into voice vs documents vs meetings; M22 into packaging vs update feed vs stores.
features.section: P. Problems found inside the three plans (fix before building)

features.feature: No dependency graph
features.detail: **No dependency graph** between milestones and rows. Fix: Generate `deps` field in `PLAN-INDEX.json` and a critical-path report; builder may not start a row whose dependencies are not green.
features.acceptance_criteria: builder may not start a row whose dependencies are not green
features.section: P. Problems found inside the three plans (fix before building)

features.feature: Duet defined three ways
features.detail: **Duet defined three ways** (Master D4 open, Addendum 1 B2.3 reviewer pair, Addendum 2 C2.3 live pairing). Fix: Ship both as one surface with two modes: *Live Pair* (ghost-text, handoff) and *Review Pair* (builder + independent reviewer). Owner confirms D4.
features.references: Master plan D4; Addendum 1 B2.3; Addendum 2 C2.3
features.section: P. Problems found inside the three plans (fix before building)

features.feature: Store distribution conflicts with "no source/no GitHub for users"
features.detail: **Store distribution conflicts with "no source/no GitHub for users"** (C1.2): Flathub requires public build manifests, some Linux stores expect open recipes. Fix: Per store, record: accepts proprietary freeware? needs public manifest? Drop stores that fail the rule; AUR binary package and self-hosted APT/YUM remain.
features.section: P. Problems found inside the three plans (fix before building)

features.feature: Free-tier trap list is incomplete
features.detail: **Free-tier trap list is incomplete:** Vercel Hobby non-commercial, VirusTotal public API non-commercial, some GitHub features limited on private free repos, Docker Desktop commercial terms. Fix: Add `FREE-TIER-REGISTER.md`: service, term used, date verified, exit plan. Re-verify at each gate.
features.section: P. Problems found inside the three plans (fix before building)

features.feature: Voice/ML licensing is stated as "check"
features.detail: **Voice/ML licensing is stated as "check"** but nothing enforces it. Fix: `MODEL-AND-VOICE-LICENSES.json` consumed by the UI license display and a CI gate; known watch items: Piper (license changed between versions), Whisper model weights, Kokoro voices, any diarization model (many carry gated or non-commercial terms), ffmpeg build flags (GPL vs LGPL).
features.acceptance_criteria: consumed by the UI license display and a CI gate
features.section: P. Problems found inside the three plans (fix before building)

features.feature: "Zero network without account" is asserted but there is no test list
features.detail: **"Zero network without account" is asserted but there is no test list.** Fix: CI job runs the full smoke suite with network namespace removed; fails on any outbound attempt (update check disabled in that job).
features.acceptance_criteria: CI job runs the full smoke suite with network namespace removed; fails on any outbound attempt (update check disabled in that job)
features.section: P. Problems found inside the three plans (fix before building)

features.feature: No risk register or rollback plan per milestone
features.detail: **No risk register or rollback plan per milestone.** Fix: `RISKS.md` (likelihood, impact, owner, mitigation) and a "revert plan" line in every milestone kickoff file.
features.section: P. Problems found inside the three plans (fix before building)

features.feature: Plan says "reimplement from behavior" but gives no clean-room procedure

plan_corrections.problem: **Priority inflation:** most rows across the addenda are P0, so P0 no longer means anything.
plan_corrections.fix: Re-rank: P0 = needed for a v1.0 that can ship safely; P1 = v1.x; P2 = later. Cap P0 at roughly 25% of rows. Builder produces the re-ranked list in `PLAN-INDEX.json`.

plan_corrections.problem: **M19 (desktop UI) is overloaded**: it receives rows from all three docs.
plan_corrections.fix: Split into M19a shell/layout, M19b chat/composer, M19c review/diff/terminal docks, M19d fleet/board/memory views, M19e settings/forms/wizard, M19f polish/a11y/i18n.
Split M11 into code-intel core vs engineering tools; M17 into voice vs documents vs meetings; M22 into packaging vs update feed vs stores.

plan_corrections.problem: **No dependency graph** between milestones and rows.
plan_corrections.fix: Generate `deps` field in `PLAN-INDEX.json` and a critical-path report; builder may not start a row whose dependencies are not green.

plan_corrections.problem: **Duet defined three ways** (Master D4 open, Addendum 1 B2.3 reviewer pair, Addendum 2 C2.3 live pairing).
plan_corrections.fix: Ship both as one surface with two modes: *Live Pair* (ghost-text, handoff) and *Review Pair* (builder + independent reviewer). Owner confirms D4.

plan_corrections.problem: **Store distribution conflicts with "no source/no GitHub for users"** (C1.2): Flathub requires public build manifests, some Linux stores expect open recipes.
plan_corrections.fix: Per store, record: accepts proprietary freeware? needs public manifest? Drop stores that fail the rule; AUR binary package and self-hosted APT/YUM remain.

plan_corrections.problem: **Free-tier trap list is incomplete:** Vercel Hobby non-commercial, VirusTotal public API non-commercial, some GitHub features limited on private free repos, Docker Desktop commercial terms.
plan_corrections.fix: Add `FREE-TIER-REGISTER.md`: service, term used, date verified, exit plan. Re-verify at each gate.

plan_corrections.problem: **Voice/ML licensing is stated as "check"** but nothing enforces it.
plan_corrections.fix: `MODEL-AND-VOICE-LICENSES.json` consumed by the UI license display and a CI gate; known watch items: Piper (license changed between versions), Whisper model weights, Kokoro voices, any diarization model (many carry gated or non-commercial terms), ffmpeg build flags (GPL vs LGPL).

plan_corrections.problem: **"Zero network without account" is asserted but there is no test list.**
plan_corrections.fix: CI job runs the full smoke suite with network namespace removed; fails on any outbound attempt (update check disabled in that job).

plan_corrections.problem: **No risk register or rollback plan per milestone.**
plan_corrections.fix: `RISKS.md` (likelihood, impact, owner, mitigation) and a "revert plan" line in every milestone kickoff file.

plan_corrections.problem: **Plan says "reimplement from behavior" but gives no clean-room procedure.**
plan_corrections.fix: Two-step process: (1) analyst pass writes a behavior spec with no code pasted; (2) builder implements from the spec only. Log which spec each module came from in the provenance file.
